messages:
elaine: kicking off canary rollout for release v2026.03 -> starting 5% traffic to new runtime
kevin: deploying now, sending traffic plan to deploy-bot
deploy-bot: rollout initiated: v2026.03 -> 5% canary across eu-west1
maria: preflight logs look green, SLO dashboards warming up
sam: noticed small p95 blip on embed-route, +30ms, probing
elaine: is that within baseline? run quick sampling
sam: running prom query: `sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/embed"}[1m])) by (le)` — looks like spike at 95th
maria: throwing up dashboard snapshot: /dashboards/slo/embed?from=now-10m
oncall-bot: SLO alert: embed-route.p95 > 200ms (count 17) — alert suppressed (canary)
kevin: can we isolate to region? is it eu-west only?
sam: yes, metrics show 90% of the spike from eu-west1
elaine: ok pinning canary to us-west and eu-west split: reduce eu-west to 0% while we triage
deploy-bot: traffic shift: eu-west1 -> 0% (removed), us-west1 -> 5% (keeps)
maria: rolling back model variant q4->q3 on eu-west2 nodes, applying fallback kernel
sam: quick grep of logs shows KV cache pressure and retries on embed worker
kevin: increasing kvcache GC threshold on eu-west2: `gc_threshold: 0.85 -> 0.92` will push small rollout
elaine: run canary for 10m on us-west then re-evaluate. if error budget burn continues, we'll rollback fully.
maria: adding release note in thread: "eu-west reduced traffic due to p95 spike on embed-route; regional pin applied; investigation underway"
sam: datapoints: 4812349999->4812350050: p95 230ms -> after pin 120ms
oncall-bot: note: alert escalations paused due to manual mitigation
kevin: pushing a minor config hotfix, will roll to eu-west staging after tests
deploy-bot: canary progress: us-west stable @ 5% for 6m
elaine: decision: hold full rollout, continue regional pin and iterate config. no full rollback. I'll add to release notes and notify pager if we need to escalate.
maria: will follow up with postmortem if error budget crosses 5% in next hour :eyes:
sam: will collect targeted traces for embed-route and link to this thread
elaine: thanks all, keep updates short here. :thumbsup:
